# ---- createChild hooks (battleship game 026241AC, cannon game 0264683C, rupee counter 026CB748): the
# screen 0x54000000 -> layout 0x54100000 -> layout screen 0x54200000 -> root pane 0x54300000 (vtable 0x54400000,
# name search = the empty 026DFD0C answered from a pick list); descriptor 0x59000000 with pane name "AB" (text
# 0x59001000) and a class name picked from S/C/B/I/X (text 0x59003000); every static pane name is "AB" or "AC",
# the class names S (SquidIcon_00), C (Cannonball_00), B (Battleship_00), I (the collection icon); all strings
# keep a real SafeString vtable (100E49C4)
